Our new toolkit is designed to equip employers in the financial and professional service sectors with everything they need to ensure diversity and inclusion of everyone, whatever their background.

The document points employers to guidance that will:

ensure talented and skilled job seekers from less privileged backgrounds are not overlooked

increase staff socio-economic diversity

encourage inclusion
